_comment: Source catalogue (i18n-l10n.md §3). ICU MessageFormat, keys hierarchical and semantic. English is the source language; every other locale is translated from this file. The backend never emits these sentences - it emits the key plus params, and the client renders them.

sync.hlc_counter_exhausted: This installation could not stamp that change.
ordering.bounds_invalid: This installation could not work out where to put that entry.
ordering.key_malformed: This installation could not work out where to put that entry.
ordering.space_exhausted: There is no room left above the first entry in this list. Sort it once, then try again.
rest.use_case_not_wired: This installation is misconfigured and cannot answer that request.
route.unknown: There is nothing at this address.
route.operation_not_available: This installation does not offer that operation yet.
dependency.unavailable: A service this feature needs cannot be reached at the moment. Everything else keeps working.
dependency.timeout: {dependency} did not answer in time. Please try again in a moment.
dependency.circuit_open: {dependency} is unreachable at the moment. Hubtask has stopped calling it and will try again shortly.
dependency.saturated: {dependency} is busy. Please try again in a moment.
dependency.target_scheme: Hubtask only calls http and https addresses. {target} is neither.
dependency.target_credentials: The address for {target} must not contain a user name or a password. Use a header instead.
dependency.target_not_allowed: {host} is not on the list of addresses this installation may call.
dependency.target_blocked: {target} points into a private or reserved network. Hubtask does not call addresses inside its own infrastructure.
dependency.target_unresolvable: The address {host} could not be resolved at the moment.
dependency.too_many_redirects: The address redirected more than {limit} times. Hubtask stopped following it.
dependency.response_too_large: The answer was larger than the permitted {limit_bytes} bytes.
search.words_too_long: A search may be at most {maximum} characters long.
query.scope_required: Say where to search: a hub, a collection, or an entry.
query.scope_ambiguous: Search in one place at a time - a container or an entry, not both.
query.scope_not_found: There is nothing to search there.
query.field_unknown: {field} is not something you can filter on here.
query.field_not_nullable: {field} always has a value, so there is nothing to search for as empty.
query.operator_unknown: {operator} is not a comparison Hubtask knows.
query.node_malformed: A condition has to be an object of field, comparison and value.
query.node_ambiguous: A condition either compares a field or combines other conditions, not both.
query.nodes_required: AND, OR and NOT need conditions to combine.
query.filter_too_deep: The search is nested more than {maximum} levels deep. Simplify it.
query.filter_too_large: The search has more than {maximum} conditions. Simplify it.
query.value_not_allowed: Searching for an empty field takes no value. Use NOT to look for the opposite.
query.value_type_invalid: {field} holds a {kind}, and the value is not one.
query.value_too_long: A search value may be at most {maximum} characters long.
query.values_required: That comparison needs a list of at least {minimum} values.
query.values_arity_invalid: That comparison takes between {minimum} and {maximum} values.
query.timestamp_malformed: That is not a date and time. Use the form 2026-08-19T14:30:00Z.
query.placeholder_unknown: {placeholder} is not something the server can fill in.
query.placeholder_offset_not_allowed: {placeholder} cannot be shifted by a duration.
query.placeholder_needs_actor: {placeholder} only means something when a person is asking.
query.offset_malformed: That is not a duration. Use the form P3D, P1W or PT2H.
query.sort_malformed: The ordering has to be a list of fields.
query.sort_too_long: Results can be ordered by at most {maximum} fields.
query.sort_duplicated: {field} is named twice in the ordering.
query.sort_direction_unknown: {value} is not a direction. Use ASC or DESC.
query.sort_nulls_unknown: {value} is not a place for empty values. Use FIRST or LAST.
query.group_by_malformed: The grouping has to be an object naming a field.
query.cursor_not_grouped: A grouped result is paged one group at a time, not as a whole.
query.count_not_supported: This installation cannot estimate how large a result is. Ask for an exact count instead.
query.count_unknown: {value} is not a way of counting. Use none or exact.
query.anchor_unknown: This installation is misconfigured and could not run that search.
query.field_not_compilable: This installation is misconfigured and could not run that search.
query.operator_not_compilable: This installation is misconfigured and could not run that search.
query.parameters_inconsistent: This installation is misconfigured and could not run that search.
query.placeholder_unresolved: This installation is misconfigured and could not run that search.
views.name_too_long: The name may be at most {maximum} characters long.
views.name_malformed: The name has to fit on one line.
views.layout_unknown: {value} is not a layout this installation stores. /meta/capabilities lists them under view_layouts.
views.sharing_unknown: {value} is not a sharing mode. Use PRIVATE or SCOPE.
views.public_link_not_available: A public link is not offered in this version. Share into the scope, or use a calendar feed for a public reader.
views.account_scope_not_shareable: A personal view names no audience to share with. Save it on the collection, the hub or the workspace to share it.
views.scope_unknown: {value} is not a view scope. Use TENANT, HUB, COLLECTION or ACCOUNT.
views.scope_id_required: This scope names a container. Send scope_id with it.
views.scope_id_not_allowed: A workspace-wide view names no container. Leave scope_id out.
views.query_required: A view is a saved query. Send one.
views.visible_field_malformed: A visible field is a short name on one line.
views.update_empty: The update names no field. Send at least one.
views.version_conflict: The view changed while you were editing it. Reload it and try again.
views.query_unencodable: This installation is misconfigured and could not store that view.
views.query_undecodable: This installation is misconfigured and could not read that view.
views.sharing_undecided: This installation is misconfigured and could not store that view.
views.identity_incomplete: This installation is misconfigured and could not store that view.
reminders.offset_spec_required: A reminder needs to say when it fires.
reminders.offset_spec_invalid: {value} is neither REL: with a duration such as -PT1H nor ABS: with a moment such as 2026-09-01T08:00:00Z.
reminders.offset_spec_too_long: That is longer than a reminder's offset may be.
reminders.offset_calendar_unit: A reminder counts in weeks, days, hours, minutes and seconds. Years and months are calendar arithmetic and would mean a different length in every month.
reminders.offset_out_of_range: That offset is longer than any reminder means.
reminders.due_date_required: A reminder counted from the due date needs the entry to have one.
reminders.channel_unknown: {value} is not a channel this installation sends on.
reminders.recipient_required: A recipient needs an account. Leave the list empty to reach the assignee and the entry's members.
reminders.recipient_without_access: That account cannot see this entry and cannot be reminded of it.
reminders.too_many: An entry carries at most {maximum} reminders.
reminders.too_many_recipients: A reminder reaches at most {maximum} named recipients. Leave the list empty to reach the assignee and the entry's members.
reminders.not_pending: That reminder is {state} and cannot be changed.
reminders.not_on_item: That reminder belongs to another entry.
reminders.update_empty: The update names no field. Send at least one.
reminders.version_conflict: The reminder changed while you were editing it. Read it again and reapply.
capacity.shed: Hubtask is under heavy load and has postponed this operation. Please try again in {retry_after_seconds} seconds.
